visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with dark hair and a black top holds the camera in a selfie perspective, smiling. Behind her, a young girl in a bright red dress stands near bags of purple and yellow produce under a rustic corrugated metal roof. (2) The scene shifts to a medium close-up of the woman and the girl interacting; the woman looks down at the girl with a questioning expression. The lighting is natural and bright. (3) A man in a white t-shirt and yellow shorts lifts the girl in the red dress onto a blue child seat on a bicycle. Other bikes and people are visible in the background in a dusty outdoor area. (4) A young boy wearing a yellow and black striped helmet sits on a bike, looking curiously at the camera. A man's hand adjusts his helmet. (5) The man in the white shirt, now wearing a red helmet and sunglasses, sits on his bike and gives a 'hang loose' gesture. (6) A series of shots show a group of cyclists traveling down a narrow paved road lined with lush green grass, tropical trees, and tall weeds. (7) POV shot from a cyclist's perspective showing the road ahead and a child's head in a yellow helmet in the foreground. (8) Inside a classroom with wooden desks, several children are writing on a large blackboard. A girl in a striped shirt and a boy in a green shirt are prominent. (9) The man carries the boy on his shoulders inside the school building, smiling at the camera. (10) Biking continues through a village with traditional stone walls and ornate gates. High-angle and wide shots capture the scenic rural landscape with expansive green rice paddies under a blue sky with white clouds. (11) The woman and the boy in the yellow helmet are seen together in a final selfie-style shot; the boy smiles and points a finger in the air excitedly.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-arousal female voice introduces the bike ride with a bright, friendly tone. Upbeat acoustic guitar BGM (approx. 120 BPM) starts immediately. (2) High-pitched child's voice yells "Me!" followed by a synthesized pop SFX. (3) Low-arousal male voice speaks calmly about biking, overlaid with natural outdoor wind noise. (4) Metallic ding SFX triggers as child's voice warns daddy to use two hands. (5) Sound of chalk scratching on a board is heard during the school visit sequence, mixed with light classroom chatter. (6) Male voice describes the downhill route with moderate energy. Music swells slightly in volume. (7) Final phase features a high-pitched child yelling "I'm not tired!" with high vocal arousal and positive valence, ending with a final pop SFX.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This family travel vlog documents a scenic bicycle tour in Ubud, Bali. The video uses a fast-paced montage of visual highlights and cute child interactions to capture the fun and cultural experiences of the trip, including a school visit and biking through rice fields, aimed at a family-oriented audience.
